query: SELECT ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN r.verification_label IS NULL THEN LENGTH(r.body) END) - AVG(CASE WHEN r.verification_label IS NOT NULL THEN LENGTH(r.body) END), 1) FROM reviews r JOIN products p ON p.category='office products' AND p.ref_id=r.ref_id AND p.status='active' WHERE r.body IS NOT NULL
columns: ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN r.verification_label IS NULL THEN LENGTH(r.body) END) - AVG(CASE WHEN r.verification_label IS NOT NULL THEN LENGTH(r.body) END), 1)
